title: Manipur CM Discusses State’s Financial Health with Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman
summary: Manipur CM Yumnam Khemchand Singh meets Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman in New Delhi, seeking central assistance and additional SASCI funding amid revenue losses.
body:
Imphal, October 29, 2026: Manipur Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh on Thursday met Union Finance and Corporate Affairs Minister Nirmala Sitharaman in New Delhi to discuss the state’s financial condition and seek enhanced central assistance, according to an official statement.

The meeting took place at Sitharaman’s office in Kartavya Bhawan, where the Chief Minister outlined the state government’s efforts to maintain financial discipline and improve fiscal management.

CM Highlights Salary and Pension Payments

During the meeting, Singh highlighted that the state government had ensured the timely payment of salaries and pensions to its employees on the first working day of every month.

He also briefed the Union Finance Minister on the progress of Externally Aided Projects (EAPs), along with the implementation of various Centrally Sponsored Schemes (CSS) and other developmental projects in Manipur.

Seeks Additional Central Assistance

Highlighting revenue losses suffered by the state over the past three years, the Chief Minister sought central support to help Manipur address its current financial challenges.

Singh also requested additional funding under the Special Assistance to States for Capital Investment (SASCI) scheme to support the state’s financial requirements.

According to the official statement, Sitharaman responded positively to the requests and assured the Chief Minister that the Centre would extend all possible assistance and support to improve Manipur’s financial health.
